summary: Delek Logistics Partners, LP filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing a quarterly distribution of $1.13 per common unit ($4.52 annualized) for Q1 2026, payable May 11 to holders of record May 4. This routine distribution declaration is a standard operational event with no special situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The registrant is the issuer of the distribution, and the filing is limited to items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Exhibits). No material corporate change, transaction, or strategic shift is disclosed. There are no deal terms to report; this is an ordinary-course capital return event.
